meta.title: Daniel Mayorga, software developer
meta.description: Portfolio of Daniel Santiago Mayorga Tellez. Grounded engineering, high-altitude ideas.

hero.name: Daniel Santiago Mayorga Tellez
hero.intro: I design interfaces and build the system underneath them, from the database to the last animation.

apex.name: APEX
apex.summary: A desktop app where twenty drivers fight for pole based on their skill, their car, the track and weather that shifts lap by lap. Tracks are drawn with the mouse.
apex.role: I designed the mockups and the JavaFX screens, and worked on the domain and the simulation engine.

hub.name: Campuslands Access Hub
hub.summary: It ran real-time attendance, teams, challenges and certificates for hundreds of participants across both days of the event.
hub.role: I built the frontend: attendance check-in, role-based views and the executive dashboard.

tenant.name: TENANT
tenant.kind: Multi-tenant platform for occupational and road safety management
tenant.summary: A database where many companies run their workplace and road safety systems without ever seeing each other's data.
tenant.role: I modeled the data, normalized it to fourth normal form and wrote the business rules in PL/pgSQL.

contact.heading: This is where the atmosphere ends.
contact.body: What comes next we can build together. I'm looking for a team where I can learn fast and ship software people use.
